\vspace{-2.5cm}

```{r setup, include=F}
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(glmhelpR)

ct <- read_csv("https://cmustatistics.github.io/data-repository/data/core-temperature.csv")
```

### Model 1

```{r, message=F}
m1 <- glm(SeriousInfection ~ TWATemp + SurgDuration + Open +
            Age + FEMALE + BMI + CharlsonScore + CHF + VALVE +
            RENLFAIL + LIVER + METS + TUMOR + COAG + 
            OBESE + LYTES + BLDLOSS + ANEMDEF + DRUG +
            SteroidHx + ImmunosuppressantHx,
          data = ct, family = binomial)
```

### Diagnostics

Quantile residual plots:

```{r, echo=F, message=F, fig.width=9, fig.height=6}
p1 <- ct |>
  mutate(res = statmod::qresid(m1)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = TWATemp, y = res)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.5) +
  geom_smooth() +
  theme_bw()

p2 <- ct |>
  mutate(res = statmod::qresid(m1)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = SurgDuration, y = res)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.5) +
  geom_smooth() +
  theme_bw()

p3 <- ct |>
  mutate(res = statmod::qresid(m1)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = CharlsonScore, y = res)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.5) +
  geom_smooth() +
  theme_bw()

p4 <- ct |>
  mutate(res = statmod::qresid(m1)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = Age, y = res)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.5) +
  geom_smooth() +
  theme_bw()

p5 <- ct |>
  mutate(res = statmod::qresid(m1)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = BMI, y = res)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.5) +
  geom_smooth() +
  theme_bw()

(p1 + p2 + p3)/(p4 + p5 + plot_spacer())
```

Cook's distance:

```{r}
summary(cooks.distance(m1))
```

Variance inflation factors:

```{r}
car::vif(m1)
```

### Model summary

```{r}
summary(m1)
```
